info.title: cakeutils public API
info.description: Token-only HTTP API of the cakeutils Velocity plugin (v2/API.md). Every route except GET /v2/health needs 'Authorization: Bearer cu_<id>_<secret>'. Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json. Times are epoch milliseconds.

get.summary: Liveness check. The only route without a token.
Servers (id, display_name, online player count, players waiting for it, mc_version, platform) and the total online.
Known players by name; filter by online state and name substring.

parameters.name: online
parameters.description: true = online now, false = everyone else; absent = all.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip.

get.summary: Identity, online state, server, first/last seen, skin, prefix/suffix segments, playtime summary.
get.description: Scopes: one of read, read:players, read:stats.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Player UUID (dashed or undashed) or exact name (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Server ids, comma-separated, left out of network-scope figures (D-113): each value becomes the network value minus those servers' values, rows that only came from them are dropped. Ignored for a server or mini scope. The answer's excluded field lists what was applied.

get.summary: Live playtime in ms: total for the scope, per server and per mini-server. Private mini-servers are left out of by_mini; their time stays in total_ms and by_server.
get.description: Scopes: one of read, read:players, read:stats.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: network (default), server:<id> or mini:<server-id>/<mini-id>. A private mini-server (public:false) answers exactly like one that was never seen, for every token.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Server ids, comma-separated, left out of network-scope figures (D-113): each value becomes the network value minus those servers' values, rows that only came from them are dropped. Ignored for a server or mini scope. The answer's excluded field lists what was applied.
